note: Risk-only review. Sanctions: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List listing found for the Indian entity; the parent group (NTN Corporation, Japan) is a Japanese bearing maker and no designation of it was located in the sources reachable. Caveat: the DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) and Bing returned only generic 'NTN' results, so sanctions screening could not be run against the official OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS lists directly — sanctions_hit is null = not verified, not a clean bill. Court cases: 8 matters found on Indian Kanoon, all tax/customs-excise litigation where the company is the appellant (CESTAT Chandigarh 2026, CESTAT Chennai 2024, ITAT Delhi 2010/2021) plus one Gujarat HC trade-mark matter where it is only mentioned as an NTN subsidiary. Per project rules these are not rejection grounds; note neutrally: 'есть сложности' — routine indirect-tax disputes, no criminal matters found. Regulator actions: none found in reachable sources (null). Credit rating: no public rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) located — null, not public in the sources checked. Negative news: none found (null). RF/CIS supply evidence: no evidence of supplies to Russia or CIS found in reachable sources — null; absence of evidence, not confirmed absence. Legal identity, HS code and shipment volumes deliberately not researched per role scope.
